subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 27, 2026
body:
nvidia no-signal boot fixed in AcreetionOS-Xlibre release-1

AcreetionOS-Xlibre no longer leaves NVIDIA owners staring at a searching monitor: a kms hook now sits in the live initramfs config, and it is merged into release-1.

Development

The fix is small and unglamorous, which is exactly why it matters. Loading the kernel modesetting driver early in the live initramfs means the display comes up instead of the no-signal void, and merging main into release-1 gets that behavior onto real images rather than leaving it in a branch. If you have ever flashed an ISO, watched the boot bar finish, and then watched your monitor look for input that never arrived, that was this bug. Current images are on the flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html and the specifics are written up in the changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Two bits of housekeeping landed alongside it. The newsletter archive had trailing periods baked into its link URLs, so the archive has been cleaned up, and acreetionos-wallpapers now tracks the AcreetionOS GitLab repo as a submodule for backgrounds, which means the wallpapers ship from the same sovereign source as everything else.

Community

The wider Arch world had a rough week, and it is worth being plain about it. The Hacker News reported more than 400 AUR packages hijacked to push an infostealer and an eBPF rootkit, and Phoronix covered a prominent Arch developer resigning after a ten-year run. Repository sovereignty is our answer to the first story, since we build from our own GitLab instance instead of a community grab bag, but the lesson travels anywhere you install software: read the PKGBUILD before you trust it.

Tip of the day

Check the hardware notes in the wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html before you flash, and verify the checksum of what you downloaded. If you are on NVIDIA and holding an older image, the no-signal fix is not in it, so grab a current ISO instead of debugging your display cable. When something does break, "no signal plus my GPU model" on Discord is enough for us to start working.
